_comentario: Define la consulta de ventas de A3ERP (CABEFACV + LINEFACT, las mismas tablas que usa el cubo de Ventas del Power BI), el mapeo y el registro de empresas (cada empresa = su propia base de datos A3ERP). La consulta usa {base} para la base de la empresa y {RANGO} para el filtro de fechas. TIPODOC: 'Cargo' = factura emitida, 'Abono' = factura rectificativa.

sqlVentas.consulta: SELECT c.FECHA AS FECHA, c.SERIE AS SERIE, CAST(c.NUMDOC AS bigint) AS NRO_DOC, c.TIPODOC AS TIPO_DOC, LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODCLI)) AS COD_CLIENTE, c.NOMCLI AS NOMBRE_CLIENTE, LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODREP)) AS COD_COMERCIAL, REPRESEN.NOMREP AS NOMBRE_COMERCIAL, c.BASEMONEDA AS BASE_IMPONIBLE, c.TOTMONEDA AS TOTAL, ISNULL(c.TOTALSUPLIDOSMON,0) AS PORTES, c.TOTDTOMONEDA AS DESC_PIE, 0 AS RAPPEL, NULL AS NRO_ALBARAN, NULL AS NRO_ANULADA, LTRIM(RTRIM(l.CODART)) AS COD_ARTICULO, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.DESCART)) AS NOMBRE_ARTICULO, l.UNIDADES AS CANTIDAD, l.PRECIO AS PRECIO, l.PRCMEDIO AS COSTE_UNITARIO, l.DESC1 AS DESC_LINEA FROM [{base}].dbo.CABEFACV c LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.REPRESEN ON REPRESEN.CODREP = c.CODREP LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.LINEFACT l ON l.IDFACV = c.IDFACV AND l.ESCOMPONENTE = 'F' LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.ARTICULO a ON a.CODART = l.CODART {RANGO}
sqlVentas.filtroFecha: WHERE c.FECHA >= CONVERT(datetime, '{desde}', 120) AND c.FECHA <= CONVERT(datetime, '{hasta}', 120)
